titleEn: Reservoir Announces $10 Million Multi-Year Partnership with John Deere to Accelerate Rugged AI for Agriculture
titleZh: Reservoir与约翰迪尔达成1000万美元合作，加速农业 rugged AI 落地
summaryZh: Reservoir在首届Ruggedize大会上宣布与约翰迪尔达成为期三年、总额1000万美元的研发合作，旨在加速高价值作物农业中坚固型AI技术的商业化。合作将补贴初创企业参与、降低准入门槛，并扩展农村创新机会。Reservoir Farms自2026年春季开放以来已吸引20多家初创企业，此次合作加上Western Growers的承诺，为其田间创新模式提供了战略支持。
featuredReason: 该合作展示了大型农机企业与初创孵化器联合推动AI在农业场景落地的模式，对智慧畜牧领域探索类似合作具有借鉴意义，尤其是坚固型AI在恶劣环境下的应用思路。
contentFull:
By Reservoir 

 

 Share

 

 

 

 

 

 At its inaugural Ruggedize conference, Reservoir announced a $10 million, three-year R&D partnership with John Deere to accelerate real-world development and commercialization of rugged AI technologies for high-value crop agriculture.

 The partnership builds on a relationship that began when Reservoir was founded in 2024 and reflects Deere’s commitment to an innovation ecosystem that moves faster from prototype to grower impact.

 “John Deere is committed to helping high-value crop growers do more with less, and that requires strong innovation built in the field, not just in the lab,” said Jason Brantley, vice president of production systems, small ag & turf at John Deere. “Real-world validation is a key part of Deere’s mission and helps ensure new solutions are addressing real challenges farmers are facing. Automation on the farm is addressing the immediate labor and efficiency needs of the industry, and Reservoir is also helping explore what innovations come next across data, connectivity and other emerging agtech solutions.”

 The partnership helps Reservoir broaden access to its on-farm technical community by subsidizing startup participation and lowering barriers for founders entering the ecosystem. It will also expand opportunities for innovation in rural communities by connecting entrepreneurs and deep-tech engineers more directly with growers, farm operations and industry partners across California, Arizona and soon other key agricultural regions.

 “We’ve been able to manifest our vision for Reservoir thanks in no small part to the generous partnership of John Deere,” said Danny Bernstein, CEO of Reservoir. “This multi-year commitment gives startups greater access to the infrastructure, field conditions and strategic relationships they need to prove the value of rugged AI for commercial agriculture faster.”

 Earlier this year, Western Growers announced its own three-year commitment to Reservoir. Together, the Deere and Western Growers commitments give Reservoir the strategic backing and grower relationships needed to advance its field-based model for rugged AI innovation.

 Reservoir announced the partnership at its inaugural Ruggedize conference, a forum focused on rugged AI and its application across agriculture and other industrial sectors, including mining and construction. With participation from leaders from USDA, the FBI, Nvidia, Google, Amazon, and leading technology companies, as well as strong support from agtech startups and established industry players, the event underscored Reservoir’s growing role as a connector between deep tech and farm-level impact.

translationZh:
在首届Ruggedize大会上，Reservoir宣布与约翰迪尔达成一项为期三年、总额1000万美元的研发合作，旨在加速坚固型AI技术在高价值作物农业中的实际开发与商业化。

该合作建立在双方自2024年Reservoir成立之初便已建立的关系之上，反映了迪尔对创新生态系统的承诺，即更快地从原型走向种植者影响。

约翰迪尔小型农业与草坪生产系统副总裁Jason Brantley表示：“约翰迪尔致力于帮助高价值作物种植者以更少的投入实现更多产出，这需要强大的创新，而这种创新必须源于田间，而非仅仅在实验室中。实地验证是迪尔使命的关键部分，有助于确保新解决方案切实解决农民面临的真实挑战。农业自动化正在解决行业当前的劳动力和效率需求，Reservoir也在帮助探索数据、连接性及其他新兴农业科技解决方案方面的下一步创新。”

该合作通过补贴初创企业参与、降低创始人进入生态系统的门槛，帮助Reservoir扩大其田间技术社区的准入。它还将通过将企业家和深度技术工程师更直接地与加州、亚利桑那州以及即将拓展的其他关键农业区域的种植者、农场运营和行业伙伴联系起来，扩大农村社区的创新机会。

自2026年春季开放萨利纳斯和索诺玛站点以来，Reservoir Farms已迎来20多家初创企业，凸显了其田间模式的早期吸引力。

Reservoir首席执行官Danny Bernstein表示：“我们能够实现Reservoir的愿景，很大程度上得益于约翰迪尔的慷慨合作。这项多年期承诺为初创企业提供了更广泛的渠道，获取基础设施、田间条件以及战略关系，从而更快地证明坚固型AI在商业农业中的价值。”

今年早些时候，Western Growers也宣布了对Reservoir的三年承诺。迪尔和Western Growers的承诺共同为Reservoir提供了战略支持和种植者关系，以推进其基于田间的坚固型AI创新模式。

Reservoir在首届Ruggedize大会上宣布了这项合作。该大会是一个聚焦坚固型AI及其在农业及其他工业领域（包括采矿和建筑）应用的论坛。来自美国农业部、联邦调查局、英伟达、谷歌、亚马逊及领先科技公司的领导者，以及农业科技初创企业和成熟行业参与者的强力支持，共同彰显了Reservoir作为深度技术与田间影响之间连接者的日益增长的角色。
